scope_registration.Std: Unparameterized Cauchy read as the standard cauchyMeasure 0 1 convention.
scope_registration.Family: Cauchy read as all location/positive-scale laws; requires same-law sample-average conclusion for arbitrary common location and positive scale.
scope_registration.evidence: Frozen H1 TASK item 4 and SOURCE prob_9_6 do not spell out location/scale or standard; old A adjudicator chose Std and the opposing reviewer chose Family.
scope_registration.rule: Preserve original A complete/partial and continuation identities. Apply both ranges to every eventual original A/B/C full candidate; do not retroactively treat old adjudicator choice as a unique frozen definition. Inspect all other inversion-chain obligations.

obligations.E1: 所有实数的复指数差界，正负与零值及真实证明。
obligations.I1: 反演公式一般概率分布公开端点，无额外无原子/密度假设；端点半质量。
obligations.I2: 有限截断的被积函数可积性、Fubini交换及界；不是把目标积分交换直接作为假设。
obligations.I3: 振荡核化简与Dirichlet积分极限的本组新证明；允许通用基础但无目标专有预给答案。
obligations.I4: 开区间内部、端点、外部各极限值；统一支配与积分极限实际闭合。
obligations.U1: 由反演公式证明特征函数唯一性；实际落实连续点稠密选择与测度确定。
obligations.C1: 独立同分布柯西样本平均同分布；Std标准与Family任意共同位置正尺度分别核查，不由未量化参数推一般结论。
obligations.C2: 教材密度语义与特征函数表征真实连接；两种范围各自可用，允许不调用唯一性定理的合法替代。
obligations.Z1: 特征函数在2π等于1推出几乎处处整数值，单位模等号及复指数周期刻画真实闭合。
obligations.Z2: 几乎处处整数值推出特征函数在2π等于1；可测与分布接口。
obligations.P1: 除柯西量词歧义以外，全部公开前提、边界与目标数学陈述正确且获任务许可。
obligations.D1: 五目标全部交付；目标专有分析支持在本组新做，依赖闭合，无循环或证明逃逸。

rule.timing: Std/Family registered before B/C first H1 dispatch. Detailed common rubric frozen after original candidates return, before new independent reviews; not original experiment preregistration.
rule.composition: For each reading combine mathematics, public_premises, route_<reading>, interface, delivery and all obligation statuses. Any fail => fail; else any unresolved => unresolved; else pass.
rule.separation: Mathematical validity under stated premises is separate from missing source domain, required proof route, interface and delivery. Cauchy range affects C1/C2 and corresponding route, not automatically all other obligations.
rule.nonranking: If scope changes labels preserve criterion_dispute; do not choose Std or Family from winner. Original A partial and same-root full continuation remain separate evidence, with no new A solver.
rule.limits: The unparameterized frozen Cauchy wording is not made uniquely standard by the old adjudicator. Read all five target proofs and permitted support; no majority-vote truth.
